buildCommand: rm -rf public && mkdir -p public/_next/static/immutable/chunks && cp -R _next/static/immutable/media public/_next/static/immutable/ && cp _next/static/immutable/chunks/*.css public/_next/static/immutable/chunks/ && for f in *; do [ -f "$f" ] && [ "$f" != vercel.json ] && cp "$f" public/; done; echo "PRUEBA SIN JS: $(find public -type f | wc -l) files, $(du -sh public | cut -f1)"
